scope: Generic structural and declared electrical constraints; no factory capability limits

sources.scope: symbol pin types, no-connect markers and electrical rule checking
installed symbol identities and pin definitions, not component ratings

rules.check: Every assigned or NC pin must exist in the resolved symbol
Connected and intentionally NC are mutually exclusive
Unconnected input or power_in pins require explicit treatment; NC on power_in never establishes valid power
Multiple push-pull outputs or power sources on a net require review
Sum of declared worst-case load currents must not exceed declared supply capacity
Declared rail voltage must lie within each declared load operating interval

Device:R.scope: CAD pin identity only; not an MPN or voltage/power rating

Device:C.scope: CAD pin identity only; not an MPN or voltage rating
